name: 4-fluoroselegiline
summary: 4-Fluoroselegiline, or p-fluoro-L-deprenyl, is a substituted amphetamine designer drug. It is the enantiopure L- enantiomer of 4-fluorodeprenyl and the 4-fluorinated derivative of selegiline (L-deprenyl).

pharmacology.text: 4-Fluoroselegiline is a selective and irreversible inhibitor of monoamine oxidase B and monoaminergic activity enhancer. A radiolabelled derivative incorporating 18F is used to study MAO-B inhibition in both in vivo and in vitro experiments.

uses.text: 4-Fluoroselegiline, or p-fluoro-L-deprenyl, is a substituted amphetamine designer drug.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Its parent drug, selegiline, can cause nausea, dizziness, dry mouth, headache and trouble sleeping.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它的母體藥物司來吉蘭可能引起噁心、頭暈、口乾、頭痛與睡眠困難。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它的母体药物司来吉兰可能引起恶心、头晕、口干、头痛与睡眠困难。

fact.en: A version of it carrying radioactive fluorine-18 is used in PET scans to see where the enzyme MAO-B sits in the living brain. Its parent drug, selegiline, was developed by József Knoll in Hungary in the 1960s.
fact.zh: 帶有放射性氟-18的版本被用於正子斷層掃描（PET），以觀察活體大腦中單胺氧化酶B（MAO-B）的分布位置。它的母體藥物司來吉蘭（selegiline）由匈牙利的Knoll József在1960年代研發。
fact.zhHans: 带有放射性氟-18的版本被用于正子断层扫描（PET），以观察活体大脑中单胺氧化酶B（MAO-B）的分布位置。它的母体药物司来吉兰（selegiline）由匈牙利的Knoll József在1960年代研发。
